silverstone.name: Silverstone Grand Prix Circuit
silverstone.description: Fast and flowing: the Maggotts-Becketts-Chapel sequence and the long Hangar Straight reward aerodynamic grip and tyre care.

spa.name: Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps
spa.description: The longest lap on the calendar: the plunge through Eau Rouge, the Kemmel Straight and the Bus Stop chicane make strategy and tyre wear very different from Silverstone.

monza.name: Autodromo Nazionale Monza
monza.description: The temple of speed: long straights, heavy braking into the chicanes and the Parabolica, with little cornering load, so tyre wear is lower than at Silverstone.

zandvoort.name: Circuit Zandvoort
zandvoort.description: A short, tight dune circuit with banked corners: the shortest lap here, so fuel burn per lap is the lowest.
